name: ai-catalog
description: Machine-readable catalog specification for AI agent discovery — robots.txt for AI capabilities. This catalog describes the ai-catalog CLI itself, so agents can discover and use the validator, linter, token meter, and converters.

capabilities.name: Catalog Validation
capabilities.description: Validate ai-catalog.json files against the official JSON Schema with human-friendly error messages

capabilities.name: Safety Linting
capabilities.description: Detect unsafe tool configurations, permission mistakes, and quality gaps beyond what schema validation catches

capabilities.name: Breaking Change Detection
capabilities.description: Compare catalog versions and flag breaking changes with semver hygiene checks

capabilities.name: Token Usage Metering
capabilities.description: Measure what a catalog costs an agent's context window, with per-tool cost breakdowns

capabilities.name: OpenAPI Conversion
capabilities.description: Convert between OpenAPI 3.x specs and ai-catalog format in both directions, preserving safety fields

capabilities.name: Web Catalog Explorer
capabilities.description: Local web UI for browsing catalogs with a visual token meter, searchable tools, and permissions view

tools.name: Validate Catalog
tools.description: Validate an ai-catalog.json file against the JSON Schema. Add --json for machine-readable output.

tools.name: Lint Catalog
tools.description: Run safety and quality checks: unsafe tools without approval gates, permission rules referencing unknown tools, stale metadata, missing examples. Nonzero exit on errors — usable as a CI gate.

path.description: Path to the catalog to lint

tools.name: Diff Catalogs
tools.description: Compare two catalog versions. Reports added/removed/modified tools and capabilities, permission changes, and breaking changes including semver violations.

tools.name: Token Usage Meter
tools.description: Estimate what a catalog costs an agent's context window: total tokens, budget bars against 8K/32K/200K windows, per-section and per-tool breakdown, warnings on heavy tools.

path.description: Path to the catalog to meter

tools.name: Import from OpenAPI
tools.description: Convert an OpenAPI 3.x spec (JSON or YAML) into ai-catalog.json. Applies safety defaults: DELETE endpoints are gated with ai_safe:false and requires_approval:true; auth schemes are mapped automatically.

tools.name: Export to OpenAPI
tools.description: Convert ai-catalog.json into an OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec. Safety fields are preserved as x-ai-safe and x-requires-approval extensions.

catalog.description: Path to the catalog to export

tools.name: Serve Web Explorer
tools.description: Launch a zero-dependency local web UI for a catalog: visual token meter, searchable tool cards with safety badges, permissions view. Serves the raw catalog at /ai-catalog.json and the token report at /tokens.json for agents.

path.description: Path to the catalog to serve

tools.name: Generate Catalog
tools.description: Interactive wizard that builds a new ai-catalog.json by asking questions. Intended for humans at a terminal, not autonomous agents.

output.description: Where to write the generated catalog
